These 24/7 online resources are designed to help students explore career options, find relevant jobs and internships, and practice critical skills like interviewing. If you have any questions about these resources, make an appointment to speak with a Career Coach. 

Alumni - Learn more about accessing resources here!

24/7 online resources

  • Exploring Options
  • Finding Jobs and Internships
  • Practicing Skills
Exploring Options

Exploring Options:

FOCUS 2

FOCUS 2 combines self-assessment, career and major exploration, decision-making and planning in a single product. Your assessment results are matched to career options and majors/programs. FOCUS 2 guides you through a career and education decision-making model to help select a major, and make informed career decisions.

  • Start FOCUS 2

Temple University Career Guide

The Career Guide is a comprehensive collection of job search resources, tips and strategies relevant to all majors and industries.

  • View the Career Guide

What Can I Do With This Major?

Whether you are exploring multiple majors or searching for information about your chosen field, this site will help you connect majors to careers. Learn about the typical career areas and the types of employers that hire people with each major, as well as strategies to make you a more marketable candidate.

  • Explore Majors
Finding Jobs and Internships

Finding Jobs and Internships:

Career Shift

Career Shift was created to help job seekers successfully navigate the published and hidden job market to find gainful employment. Career Shift has offered an online set of integrated applications proven to help job seekers since 2007.

  • Visit site

Handshake

Handshake serves as Temple University's virtual career center and provides thousands of job and internship postings from 200,000+ employers. Students can customize their job search, apply for jobs and internships, and even schedule an appointment with a career coach using this comprehensive virtual resource.

  • Schedule an appointment
  • View Jobs and Internships
  • View events
Practicing Skills

Practicing Skills:

AAUW Start Smart

The American Association of University Women (AAUW) is working with partners across communities, cities, and states to offer free salary negotiation workshops to eliminate the gender pay gap for good. These salary negotiation courses can be taken online by clicking the above link, or an in-person presentation by Career Center staff can be requested for your class or organization.

  • Visit site

Big Interview

With Big Interview you can:

  • Review common interview questions and answers by industry and experience level
  • Draft your own answers to popular interview questions
  • Record mock interviews and get AI feedback!
  • Watch videos about the entire job search and interview process
  • Share your mock interview videos with faculty, advisors, or mentors for critique

Big Interview also offers resources specific to multiple identities and affinities in their Industry Playbooks.

  • Visit site

Jobscan

Boost your interview chances by optimizing your resume keywords against job descriptions with Jobscan. Jobscan compares your resume with any job description you choose and identifies changes you can make to maximize your chances of being selected by recruiters and Applicant Tracking Systems.

  • Visit site

LinkedIn Learning

Access free LinkedIn Learning courses through the TU portal. LinkedIn Learning provides thousands of instructional videos and training on business, creativity and technology topics taught by industry experts. 

  • Learn more
